title: The King in the Mists (Pinnacle) Boss Guide: Ritual Access, Wisp Maze, Chaos Prep and Audience with the King
summary: Path of Exile 2 Ritual pinnacle boss guide: how the Pinnacle King differs from the Act 1 version, Audience with the King access, Portent Vapours, Wisp Maze, and chaos resistance prep.
description: Beat The King in the Mists pinnacle in PoE2. Disambiguation from Act 1, Ritual access, platform/maze mechanics, chaos prep, community evidence and Omen/Unique drops.

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: This page is the RITUAL PINNACLE King (Audience with the King at Tier 14+), NOT the Act 1 Story boss. They share a name but different arenas and rewards.
calloutDetail: You earn An Audience with the King by farming Tribute in Ritual encounters and filling the Audience bar, then scanning the Atlas for the encounter at Tier 14+.
The fight layers Portent Vapours (debuff clouds), a Wisp Maze, and a final chaos phase. Cap Chaos Resistance and keep moving — standing still on a platform is deadly.

items.question: Is this the same King in the Mists from Act 1?
answer: No. Act 1 has a story-version King in the Mists. This page covers the Ritual PINNACLE version (Audience with the King) that appears at Tier 14+ maps.
Different arena, mechanics (Portent Vapours, Wisp Maze), and rewards (Omen / Unique). If you searched the Act 1 boss, that is a separate encounter.

items.question: How do I currently get the Audience / entrance?
answer: Farm Ritual encounters for Tribute, offer it until the Audience bar fills, granting An Audience with the King.
Keep it in your inventory and scan the Atlas; at Tier 14+ the encounter escalates into the true pinnacle fight.

items.question: Why can't I stay on a platform?
answer: Portent Vapours and the maze mechanics punish stationary play; platforms are safe spots only briefly. The King's chaos attacks cover ground you must keep leaving.

items.question: What's the difference between Guaranteed Omen and Unique chance drop?
answer: An Audience guarantees an Omen (a Ritual currency) on completion. Uniques are a chance drop from the loot pool, not guaranteed.

steps.label: Farm Ritual Tribute
body: Run Ritual encounters in your maps; accumulate Tribute and fill the Audience bar by offering.

steps.label: Receive An Audience with the King
body: Once the bar fills you get the item. Keep it in inventory.

steps.label: Scan the Atlas (Tier 14+)
body: At Tier 14+ the encounter escalates. Travel the Atlas until the ritual portal appears and enter.

sections.title: Version Disambiguation
paragraphs: There are TWO King in the Mists encounters in PoE2. The Act 1 story version is a campaign boss you fight during the main quest. This page is the RITUAL PINNACLE version reached via An Audience with the King at Tier 14+.
Do not follow Act 1 guides for this fight — the arena, the Portent Vapours, the Wisp Maze, and the reward structure are all different. If your goal is the campaign boss, that is a separate page.
bullets: Act 1: story boss, no Audience item, different loot.
Pinnacle (this page): Audience item, Tier 14+, Omen + Unique pool.
Same name, different fight — read the access section to confirm which you need.

sections.title: Wisp Maze Guide
paragraphs: The Wisp Maze is a sequence of safe lanes between hazard zones. Read it before committing: enter a lane only when the hazard behind you is clearing, and always keep the next lane in view.

Maze failure (getting cornered) and fight failure (death) are different — maze failure just resets positioning; death costs the attempt. Prioritise Affliction Totems and Fetishes so the maze stays navigable.
bullets: Enter a lane as the trailing hazard clears.
Kill Totems/Fetishes so lanes stay open.
If cornered, dodge toward the known safe gap, not the wall.

items.label: Capped Chaos Resistance
items.why: The King's final phase and many abilities deal Chaos; uncapped chaos res means rapid death.
items.fix: Chaos-crafted gear, Chaos Resistance rolls, or a Chaos-charm.

items.label: Movement speed
items.why: Portent Vapours and maze require constant repositioning.
items.fix: Movement-speed suffixes or a movement skill.

items.label: Wither mitigation
checks: Check for sources of Wither (chaos DoT amp).
items.why: Wither stacks amplify chaos damage taken; clear them fast.
items.fix: Flask or passive that removes Wither; kill Wisp sources.

items.label: Ranged/melee positioning
items.why: The arena is platform-based; melee must commit, ranged must keep LoS.
items.fix: Pre-scout platform safe spots in a practice run.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Vapours & Maze (100%–~40%)
notes: The King layers Portent Vapours (debuff clouds) and a Wisp Maze. Affliction Totems, Fetishes and Blood Pool appear and must be prioritised.
Platforms are only briefly safe; do not camp them.
objectives: Navigate the Wisp Maze without getting cornered.
Dodge Affliction Totems / Fetishes / Blood Pool.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Chaos Finale (~40%–0%)
phases.trigger: At low HP the chaos phase intensifies.
notes: The final phase floods the arena with chaos effects; movement and chaos res are everything. Rat Tornado overlaps with cage mechanics at times.
objectives: Burst him down before coverage wins.

attacks.name: Portent Vapours
telegraph: Coloured vapour clouds spread across the arena.
responses: Walk out of the cloud; it applies stacking de-buffs. Keep moving.
notes: Clouds linger; camping a platform inside one is fatal.

attacks.name: Affliction Totem
responses: Destroy it first; it amplifies or spawns hazards.

attacks.name: Fetish / Blood Pool
telegraph: Fetishes spawn; Blood Pool appears on ground.
responses: Clear Fetishes; avoid standing in Blood Pool.

attacks.name: Rat Tornado + Cage
telegraph: A swirling Rat Tornado overlaps with a cage mechanic.
responses: Move to the safe gap; do not get trapped between tornado and cage.
notes: Overlap is the trickiest positioning test.

attacks.name: Chaos Finale Burst
responses: Keep moving and rely on chaos res; burst him down.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: The pinnacle arena is a platform-based space threaded by a Wisp Maze. Portent Vapours drift across it, and the King uses cages and Rat Tornadoes to restrict movement.
Platforms look safe but Vapours and Totems make them temporary. The maze phase forces you to keep a clear escape route at all times.
bullets: Never camp a platform — Vapours drift over it.
Keep an exit from any cage/Rat Tornado overlap.
Use the maze lanes, do not cut across hazards.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Chaos Resistance is the single most important stat — the entire fight is chaos-shaped. High movement speed is second. The platform maze favours builds that can both commit (melee) and kite (ranged) without getting cornered.
Wither stacks amplify chaos damage taken; bring a way to clear or avoid them.
bullets: Melee: commit during Totem/Fetish downtime, retreat before Vapours drift.
Ranged: hold LoS from platforms, kite Rat Tornadoes.
Minion: bodies can body-block Vapours but die to chaos coverage.
Avoid low-mobility towers — the maze will corner you.

entries.question: Is this the Act 1 King?
summary: Frequent confusion: players followed Act 1 guides and failed. The pinnacle King needs an Audience item and has different mechanics.
editorialAnalysis: We confirm this page is the Tier 14+ Ritual pinnacle; Act 1 is a separate encounter with separate loot.
officialAnswer: No — this is the Ritual pinnacle (Audience item, Tier 14+). Act 1 King is a different fight.

entries.question: Why do I die on platforms?
summary: Forum posts note Portent Vapours drift over platforms; camping is the common mistake.
editorialAnalysis: Our testing: Vapours apply stacking de-buffs; never camp. Keep rotating.
officialAnswer: Platforms are briefly safe only. Keep moving; don't camp.

problems.symptom: I keep dying in the Wisp Maze
directAnswer: Use the maze lanes only, kill Totems/Fetishes to keep them open, and always keep the next lane in view.

problems.symptom: Chaos damage melts me despite resist
directAnswer: Cap chaos res, clear Wither sources, and stop standing in Vapour clouds.

problems.symptom: Got cornered by Rat Tornado + Cage
directAnswer: Dodge toward the known safe gap, not the wall. Pre-position before the overlap.
checks: Did you commit without an exit?
